## Setup

Receiver model and USB vendor/product ID, mouse and optional keyboard model, operating systems, Flow release and Options+ version. Omit serial numbers and hardware identifiers unique to your devices.

## Results

Record each as worked, failed or untested: receiver inventory, peer discovery, physical crossing in each direction, keyboard follow, and text/image/file paste in each direction. Include the relevant settings and any reproducible limitations.
